statement: Cross-references and citations take IEEE forms: "(1)", not "Eq. (1)" or "equation (1)", except "Equation (1)" at a sentence start; "Fig. 3" even at a sentence start; never abbreviate "Table"; "[3]", not "Ref. [3]", except at a sentence start; a part of a source as "[1, Fig. 2]", "[1, eq. (8)]", "[1, Sec. IV]", never "Fig. 2 of [1]"; no author name before a citation number ("Smith [1]") unless the sentence needs the name; never a year as an identifier.
why: IEEE author guide and editorial style.
provenance: P14, P24 (S5 References); merged ieee.cross-reference-forms + ieee.part-citation + ieee.no-author-before-number (user review 2026-11-23 P2-G6)
